examples.en: There is a large globe on the teacher's desk.
examples.zh: 老師的桌上有一個大地球儀。

examples.en: Our company has offices all around the globe.
examples.zh: 我們公司在全球各地都有辦公室。

examples.en: The glass globe hung from the ceiling above the table.
examples.zh: 那個玻璃球體掛在桌子上方的天花板上。

examples.en: The team had a glorious victory in the final game.
examples.zh: 這支球隊在決賽中取得了光榮的勝利。

examples.en: We enjoyed a glorious sunset from the hotel balcony.
examples.zh: 我們在飯店陽台欣賞了絕美的夕陽。

examples.en: It was a glorious morning, so we went for a walk.
examples.zh: 那是個美好的早晨，所以我們去散步。

examples.en: The store sells goods from many different countries.
examples.zh: 這家商店販售來自許多不同國家的商品。

examples.en: Please check that all the goods arrived safely.
examples.zh: 請確認所有貨物都安全送達。

examples.en: Trucks carry goods from the factory to the market.
examples.zh: 卡車把貨物從工廠運到市場。

examples.en: She wore a long white gown to the wedding.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件白色長禮服去參加婚禮。

examples.en: Every student put on a gown for the ceremony.
examples.zh: 每位學生都穿上袍子參加典禮。

examples.en: The nurse handed me a hospital gown to change into.
examples.zh: 護理師遞給我一件病人袍讓我換上。

examples.en: The dancer moved across the stage with grace.
examples.zh: 那位舞者優雅地走過舞台。

examples.en: He accepted the loss with grace and a smile.
examples.zh: 他帶著風度和微笑接受了落敗。

examples.en: The bank gave us a week of grace to pay.
examples.zh: 銀行給了我們一週的寬限期來付款。

examples.en: A beautiful painting graces the wall of our living room.
examples.zh: 一幅美麗的畫為我們客廳的牆面增添光彩。

examples.en: The singer graced the party with her presence.
examples.zh: 那位歌手蒞臨派對，為派對增光。

examples.en: Flowers graced every table at the dinner.
examples.zh: 晚宴的每張桌子都以鮮花點綴。

examples.en: The swan is a graceful bird.
examples.zh: 天鵝是一種優雅的鳥。

examples.en: She made a graceful turn on the ice.
examples.zh: 她在冰上做了一個優美的轉身。

examples.en: He gave a graceful reply to the rude question.
examples.zh: 他對那個無禮的問題做了得體的回答。

examples.en: Our host was gracious and made us feel welcome.
examples.zh: 主人很親切，讓我們感到賓至如歸。

examples.en: She was gracious enough to forgive my mistake.
examples.zh: 她寬宏大量，原諒了我的錯誤。

examples.en: Thank you for your gracious invitation to dinner.
examples.zh: 謝謝您誠摯邀請我們共進晚餐。

examples.en: Her parents will attend her graduation in June.
examples.zh: 她的父母六月會出席她的畢業典禮。

examples.en: After graduation, he plans to work abroad.
examples.zh: 畢業後，他打算到國外工作。

examples.en: We took many photos on graduation day.
examples.zh: 我們在畢業那天拍了很多照片。

examples.en: Our teacher explains English grammar very clearly.
examples.zh: 我們的老師把英文文法解釋得很清楚。

examples.en: This essay has some mistakes in grammar and spelling.
examples.zh: 這篇作文在文法和拼字上有一些錯誤。

examples.en: I bought a grammar book to prepare for the test.
examples.zh: 我買了一本文法書來準備考試。

examples.en: I am grateful for your help with my homework.
examples.zh: 我很感激你幫我寫功課。

examples.en: The family was grateful to the kind neighbors.
examples.zh: 這家人很感謝那些善良的鄰居。

examples.en: We would be grateful if you could reply soon.
examples.zh: 若您能盡快回覆，我們將不勝感激。

examples.en: She wrote a card to show her gratitude.
examples.zh: 她寫了一張卡片表達感謝之意。

examples.en: He bowed in gratitude to his teachers.
examples.zh: 他向老師們鞠躬致謝。

examples.en: Please accept our deep gratitude for your support.
examples.zh: 請接受我們對您支持的由衷感謝。

examples.en: We placed flowers on my grandfather's grave.
examples.zh: 我們在祖父的墳前獻上了花。

examples.en: The old grave was covered with moss.
examples.zh: 那座老墳長滿了青苔。

examples.en: Many people visit the graves during the festival.
examples.zh: 許多人在節日期間去掃墓。

examples.en: The doctor said the situation was grave.
examples.zh: 醫師說情況很嚴重。

examples.en: The manager made a grave mistake in the report.
examples.zh: 經理在報告中犯了嚴重的錯誤。

examples.en: He wore a grave expression when he came in.
examples.zh: 他進來時神情嚴肅。

examples.en: I do not like greasy food in the morning.
examples.zh: 我早上不喜歡吃油膩的食物。

examples.en: His hands were greasy after fixing the bike.
examples.zh: 他修完腳踏車後，雙手沾滿了油汙。

examples.en: Wipe the greasy pan with a paper towel.
examples.zh: 用紙巾把油膩的平底鍋擦一擦。

examples.en: She gave me a warm greeting at the door.
examples.zh: 她在門口熱情地向我打招呼。

examples.en: A friendly greeting can brighten someone's day.
examples.zh: 一句友善的問候就能讓人心情愉快。

examples.en: We sent holiday greetings to all our clients.
examples.zh: 我們向所有客戶寄出了節日賀詞。

examples.en: She felt deep grief after losing her pet.
examples.zh: 她失去寵物後感到非常悲痛。

examples.en: The whole town shared the family's grief.
examples.zh: 全鎮的人都分擔這家人的哀傷。

examples.en: Time helped him get over his grief.
examples.zh: 時間幫助他走出了悲傷。

examples.en: Please grind the coffee beans before making coffee.
examples.zh: 請在煮咖啡前先把咖啡豆磨碎。

examples.en: He ground the pepper over his salad.
examples.zh: 他把胡椒磨到沙拉上。

examples.en: The machine can grind rice into fine powder.
examples.zh: 這部機器可以把米磨成細粉。

senses.zh: 苦差事；單調辛勞的工作

examples.en: The grind of office work made him tired.
examples.zh: 辦公室的單調苦差事讓他很疲倦。

examples.en: Studying for exams can be a real grind.
examples.zh: 準備考試有時真是件苦差事。

examples.en: She was ready for the grind of a new school year.
examples.zh: 她已準備好面對新學年的辛勞。

examples.en: The phone comes with a one-year guarantee.
examples.zh: 這支手機有一年的保固。

examples.en: There is no guarantee that it will stop raining.
examples.zh: 沒有人能保證雨會停。

examples.en: The store offers a money-back guarantee.
examples.zh: 這家商店提供退費保證。

examples.en: We guarantee delivery within three days.
examples.zh: 我們保證三天內送達。

examples.en: Hard work does not guarantee success.
examples.zh: 努力並不保證成功。

examples.en: The company guarantees the quality of its products.
examples.zh: 這家公司保證其產品的品質。

examples.en: A guardian must sign the form for the school trip.
examples.zh: 校外教學的表格必須由監護人簽名。

examples.en: The old man became the child's legal guardian.
examples.zh: 那位老先生成為這個孩子的法定監護人。

examples.en: Rangers act as guardians of the national park.
examples.zh: 護管員是國家公園的守護者。

examples.en: He felt guilt about forgetting her birthday.
examples.zh: 他因為忘記她的生日而感到愧疚。

examples.en: The court could not prove his guilt.
examples.zh: 法院無法證明他有罪。

examples.en: She carried a heavy sense of guilt for years.
examples.zh: 她多年來一直背負著沉重的罪惡感。

examples.en: I felt guilty about breaking my friend's cup.
examples.zh: 我對打破朋友的杯子感到內疚。

examples.en: The judge found him guilty of the crime.
examples.zh: 法官認定他有罪。

examples.en: She had a guilty look on her face.
examples.zh: 她臉上露出心虛的表情。

examples.en: The ship sailed across the gulf at dawn.
examples.zh: 那艘船在黎明時橫渡海灣。

examples.en: There is a wide gulf between rich and poor.
examples.zh: 貧富之間有很大的鴻溝。

examples.en: A gulf of opinion separated the two teams.
examples.zh: 兩個團隊的意見有很大的差距。

examples.en: He is a habitual late sleeper on weekends.
examples.zh: 他週末習慣性地晚起。

examples.en: Her habitual smile made everyone feel relaxed.
examples.zh: 她一貫的笑容讓大家都感到輕鬆。

examples.en: Habitual lateness can upset your coworkers.
examples.zh: 習慣性遲到可能讓同事不高興。

examples.en: The bus halted at the red light.
examples.zh: 公車在紅燈前停了下來。

examples.en: The storm halted all train service.
examples.zh: 暴風雨使所有火車停駛。

examples.en: Please halt the video so I can take notes.
examples.zh: 請暫停影片，讓我記筆記。

examples.en: The car came to a halt outside the school.
examples.zh: 那輛車在學校外面停了下來。

examples.en: The strike brought work to a halt.
examples.zh: 罷工讓工作中止。

examples.en: Traffic ground to a halt on the bridge.
examples.zh: 橋上的車流完全停住了。

examples.en: Her handwriting is neat and easy to read.
examples.zh: 她的字跡工整，很容易閱讀。

examples.en: I could not read the doctor's handwriting.
examples.zh: 我看不懂醫師的筆跡。

examples.en: Good handwriting can make a better first impression.
examples.zh: 一手好字能給人更好的第一印象。

examples.en: The family faced great hardship after the flood.
examples.zh: 水災過後，這家人面臨極大的困境。

examples.en: She overcame many hardships to finish school.
examples.zh: 她克服了許多困難才完成學業。

examples.en: Many people suffered financial hardship last year.
examples.zh: 許多人去年遭遇經濟上的困難。

examples.en: The computer needs new hardware to run faster.
examples.zh: 這台電腦需要更新硬體才能跑得更快。

examples.en: My father bought some tools at the hardware store.
examples.zh: 我父親在五金行買了一些工具。

examples.en: The school spent money on classroom hardware.
examples.zh: 學校花錢購買教室的硬體設備。

examples.en: The neighbors live together in harmony.
examples.zh: 鄰居們和睦相處。

examples.en: The choir sang in perfect harmony.
examples.zh: 合唱團唱出完美的和聲。

examples.en: Colors in the room are in harmony with each other.
examples.zh: 這個房間的色彩彼此協調。

examples.en: The teacher's words were too harsh for the young boy.
examples.zh: 老師的話對那個小男孩來說太嚴厲了。

examples.en: The harsh winter lasted for four months.
examples.zh: 嚴酷的冬天持續了四個月。

examples.en: The harsh light hurt my eyes.
examples.zh: 刺眼的光線弄痛了我的眼睛。

examples.en: The story shows how hatred can hurt a family.
examples.zh: 這個故事說明仇恨如何傷害一個家庭。

examples.en: He has a strong hatred of lies.
examples.zh: 他非常痛恨謊言。

examples.en: Kindness is the best answer to hatred.
examples.zh: 善良是對付仇恨的最好方式。

examples.en: A hawk circled above the open field.
examples.zh: 一隻鷹在空曠的田野上空盤旋。

examples.en: The hawk caught a small mouse in its claws.
examples.zh: 那隻鷹用爪子抓住一隻小老鼠。

examples.en: We watched a hawk build a nest in the tall tree.
examples.zh: 我們看著一隻鷹在高大的樹上築巢。

examples.en: A herd of cows crossed the road slowly.
examples.zh: 一群乳牛慢慢穿過馬路。

examples.en: The farmer watched his herd on the hill.
examples.zh: 農夫在山丘上看顧他的牛群。

examples.en: We saw a herd of elephants near the river.
examples.zh: 我們在河邊看到一群大象。

examples.en: The dog helped herd the sheep into the barn.
examples.zh: 那隻狗幫忙把羊趕進穀倉。

examples.en: The guide herded the tourists onto the bus.
examples.zh: 導遊把遊客趕上巴士。

examples.en: The teacher herded the children out of the room.
examples.zh: 老師把孩子們趕出教室。

examples.en: She answered the teacher's question without any hesitation.
examples.zh: 她毫不猶豫地回答了老師的問題。

examples.en: I felt some hesitation before signing the contract.
examples.zh: 簽約前我有些遲疑。

examples.en: His hesitation made the teacher wait.
examples.zh: 他的遲疑讓老師等了一會兒。

examples.en: The farmer put a new hive in the garden.
examples.zh: 農夫在花園裡放了一個新蜂箱。

examples.en: Bees fly in and out of the hive all day.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂整天在蜂巢進進出出。

examples.en: The honey from this hive tastes sweet.
examples.zh: 這個蜂巢產的蜂蜜嚐起來很甜。

examples.en: Many people left their homeland to find work.
examples.zh: 許多人離開祖國去找工作。

examples.en: He returned to his homeland after ten years.
examples.zh: 他在十年後回到了故鄉。

examples.en: She misses the food of her homeland.
examples.zh: 她懷念家鄉的食物。

examples.en: They spent their honeymoon on a quiet island.
examples.zh: 他們在一座寧靜的小島上度蜜月。

examples.en: The couple left for their honeymoon on Sunday.
examples.zh: 這對新人週日出發去蜜月旅行。

examples.en: We booked a hotel for our honeymoon.
examples.zh: 我們為蜜月旅行訂了一間飯店。

examples.en: Please hang your coat on the hook by the door.
examples.zh: 請把外套掛在門邊的掛鉤上。

examples.en: He caught a fish with a small hook.
examples.zh: 他用一個小鉤子釣到一條魚。

examples.en: The picture fell when the hook broke.
examples.zh: 掛鉤斷掉時，那幅畫掉了下來。

examples.en: I hooked my bag on the back of the chair.
examples.zh: 我把包包掛在椅背上。

examples.en: Please hook the trailer to the truck.
examples.zh: 請把拖車連接到卡車上。

examples.en: The sleeve hooked on a nail and tore.
examples.zh: 袖子勾到釘子而破了。

examples.en: The sun slowly sank below the horizon.
examples.zh: 太陽慢慢沉入地平線下。

examples.en: We saw a ship on the horizon.
examples.zh: 我們看見地平線上有一艘船。

examples.en: Traveling can broaden your horizons.
examples.zh: 旅行可以拓展你的視野。

examples.en: The news about the accident horrified everyone.
examples.zh: 那起意外的消息讓所有人驚駭不已。

examples.en: Her messy room would horrify her mother.
examples.zh: 她凌亂的房間會讓她媽媽嚇壞。

examples.en: The size of the bill horrified us.
examples.zh: 帳單的金額嚇壞了我們。

examples.en: He used a hose to water the garden.
examples.zh: 他用水管幫花園澆水。

examples.en: The garden hose is too short to reach the tree.
examples.zh: 這條園藝水管太短，搆不到那棵樹。

examples.en: A firefighter pulled the long hose off the truck.
examples.zh: 一位消防員把長長的水管從車上拉了下來。

examples.en: Every household in the village received a notice.
examples.zh: 村裡每戶人家都收到了通知。

examples.en: A large household needs a lot of food.
examples.zh: 人口多的家庭需要很多食物。

examples.en: The survey asked about each household's income.
examples.zh: 這項調查詢問了每個家庭的收入。

examples.en: We bought some household items at the market.
examples.zh: 我們在市場買了一些家用品。

examples.en: Washing dishes is a basic household task.
examples.zh: 洗碗是一項基本的家務。

examples.en: Her household budget is carefully planned.
examples.zh: 她的家庭預算規劃得很仔細。

examples.en: The discovery helped all of humanity.
examples.zh: 這項發現造福了全人類。

examples.en: He showed great humanity toward the poor.
examples.zh: 他對窮人展現了極大的仁愛。

examples.en: The museum tells the story of humanity's past.
examples.zh: 博物館講述人類的過去。

examples.en: The humidity is high in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天的濕度很高。

examples.en: High humidity makes the room feel warmer.
examples.zh: 高濕度讓房間感覺更悶熱。

examples.en: We bought a machine to lower the humidity.
examples.zh: 我們買了一台機器來降低濕度。

examples.en: A hurricane hit the coast last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚有颶風襲擊海岸。

examples.en: People left the area before the hurricane arrived.
examples.zh: 颶風來臨前，人們離開了該地區。

examples.en: The hurricane brought heavy rain to the island.
examples.zh: 颶風為這座島帶來豪雨。

examples.en: The mother tried to hush the crying baby.
examples.zh: 媽媽試著讓哭泣的寶寶安靜下來。

examples.en: Hush, the movie is about to start.
examples.zh: 噓，電影快開始了。

examples.en: The teacher hushed the class with a quiet word.
examples.zh: 老師輕聲一句話就讓班上安靜下來。

examples.en: A hush fell over the room when she spoke.
examples.zh: 她一開口，房間裡便安靜下來。

examples.en: The library was in a deep hush.
examples.zh: 圖書館一片寂靜。

examples.en: There was a hush before the music began.
examples.zh: 音樂開始前一片肅靜。

examples.en: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen.
examples.zh: 水是由氫和氧組成的。

examples.en: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
examples.zh: 氫是最輕的元素。

examples.en: Some new buses run on hydrogen.
examples.zh: 有些新型公車使用氫氣作為燃料。

senses.zh: 完全相同的；一模一樣的

examples.en: The twins wore identical shirts to school.
examples.zh: 雙胞胎穿著一模一樣的襯衫去上學。

examples.en: These two bags look identical to me.
examples.zh: 這兩個包包在我看來一模一樣。

examples.en: Her answer was identical to mine.
examples.zh: 她的答案和我的完全相同。

examples.en: Please show your identification at the entrance.
examples.zh: 請在入口處出示身分證件。

examples.en: The identification of the bird took a long time.
examples.zh: 辨認那隻鳥花了很長的時間。

examples.en: Students need identification to borrow books.
examples.zh: 學生需要證件才能借書。

examples.en: Can you identify the man in this photo?
examples.zh: 你能認出這張照片裡的男子嗎？

examples.en: The doctor identified the cause of the pain.
examples.zh: 醫師找出了疼痛的原因。

examples.en: Students must identify the main idea of the text.
examples.zh: 學生必須找出文章的主旨。

examples.en: Our teacher gave us a list of common English idioms.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們一份常見英文慣用語的清單。

examples.en: I learned a new idiom from my teacher in class.
examples.zh: 我在課堂上從老師那裡學到一個新的慣用語。

examples.en: The idiom does not mean what the words say.
examples.zh: 這個慣用語的意思和字面不同。

senses.zh: 閒置的；無所事事的；懶散的

examples.en: The factory machines were idle during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假日期間，工廠的機器處於閒置狀態。

examples.en: He spent an idle afternoon on the sofa.
examples.zh: 他在沙發上無所事事地度過了一個下午。

examples.en: Idle talk will not solve the problem.
examples.zh: 空談無法解決問題。

examples.en: The driver let the engine idle while waiting.
examples.zh: 司機等待時讓引擎空轉。

examples.en: They idled away the summer by the lake.
examples.zh: 他們在湖邊虛度了夏天。

examples.en: Do not idle in the hallway between classes.
examples.zh: 下課時間不要在走廊閒晃。
